whatIsIt.eli5: Makes the map half as big by averaging, then (in small models) doubles the kinds of notes.
whatIsIt.simple: 2×2 average pooling, then a 1×1 Conv that doubles the channels (n/s) or nothing (l/x).

whyExists.eli5: To send the group finder's notes to the smallest map size.
whyExists.simple: Produces the P5-sized copy of the HyperACE output for the FullPAD tunnel at P5.

simple: 1×1 Conv to twice the channels (small models).
